name: story10-real-agent-ambiguity-contract-parks
description: Verbatim spec-agent output from a LIVE run of the SupportFlow challenge's Story 10 (an overdue rule with no definition). The agent honours its own documented ambiguity contract — verdict 'fail' PLUS a questions array — and refuses to invent a business rule. gate-1 must route this to Checkpoint 1, not discard it as a malformed story. The hand-authored version of this case used verdict 'pass' and therefore never exercised the real path.

spec-agent.title: Highlight overdue high-priority tickets
spec-agent.problem: Support managers currently have no explicit way to identify high-priority tickets that are overdue.
spec-agent.why: Important cases are forgotten when nothing distinguishes them in the list.
acceptance_criteria: The system identifies high-priority tickets as overdue according to a clearly defined overdue rule.
Overdue high-priority tickets are highlighted in the support agent ticket list.

tasks.title: Define overdue rule and API contract
tasks.purpose: settle the rule before building on it
tasks.completion_evidence: the rule is written down and approved

tasks.title: Expose overdue flag in ticket listing
Render overdue highlight in frontend ticket list

questions: What exact rule defines an overdue ticket: age since creation, time since last update, due date field, SLA by priority, or something else?
Where must the highlighting appear: ticket list only, dashboard, ticket detail page, or multiple places?
What visual treatment counts as highlighted, and are there accessibility requirements such as text labels or ARIA attributes?
Should overdue status be filterable or searchable, or only visually highlighted?
